description: young woman princess of darkness, an assassin, pale skin, long silver hair, glowing violet eyes, standing in the middle of the image, the whole figure from the top of the head to the feet and the whole weapon inside the image, about four fifths of the image height, empty space on every side, nothing touching the edges of the image, highly detailed pixel art with fine details, rich textures and ornaments, crisp clean outlines, legendary and majestic, far more powerful and richly equipped than an ordinary hero, a godlike ultimate form, grander and more radiant than any legendary hero, a long black coat whose edges dissolve into dark smoke, ornate black armour with glowing violet lines, a thin crown of black spikes, eyes glowing violet, holding two long curved black daggers trailing violet shadow, the whole daggers inside the image, elegant and deadly, facing the viewer, three-quarter view, isolated figure on a plain background, forest fantasy

references.usage: the same woman: the same face, hair and build, drawn the same way; now in a far grander, godlike outfit and weapon of the same kind, not this outfit
